title: STATISTICAL FORM FOR ALL SCHOOLS, 2026
introduction: To be filled by the Headteacher. Kindly fill this form and return it, through the Father in charge of schools, to the Diocesan Education Secretariat. Please, provide the most recent information.
objectives: i) To collect data on academic performance, enrolment and staffing in schools
ii) To compile information on areas of special need in order to inform project/intervention planning.
